providers.title: Provider Status

providers.monitoringPausedEmpty: Monitoring is paused. Enable it to see live provider status.

workers.title: Workers
workers.description: Manage agent worker processes. Spawn and monitor workers.
workers.workerProcessesDescription: Workers with auto-start enabled will spawn on API boot and auto-restart on crash. Toggle auto-start in the Agent configuration page.
workers.spawnWorkerDescription: Choose which configuration to use when spawning this worker. "Current Draft" uses the latest saved (unpublished) configuration.
workers.noWorkersDiscovered: No workers discovered. Create a worker file in the src/agent-worker/workers/ directory and configure an agent with auto-start.

agent.title: Agent Configuration
agent.description: Edit instructions and knowledge base for your voice agent.
agent.instructionsDescription: Define how the agent should behave. Changes are applied on the next call without restarting the worker.
agent.runtimeConfigDescription: Model, voice, VAD, humanization, timeouts and greeting. Applied on the next call.
agent.modelAndVoiceDescription: Choose the LLM model and text-to-speech (TTS) engine. Realtime models have built-in STT. Pipeline mode uses external STT (Deepgram, Whisper).
agent.greetingPlaceholder: Welcome to the service center. To help you better, could you please tell me your name?
agent.voiceIdPlaceholder: Paste the Voice ID from your ElevenLabs library...
agent.defaultToolsExist: Default tools already exist for this agent
agent.toolDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe what this tool does — the LLM uses this to decide when to call it.
agent.waitMessagePlaceholder:
Hmm, let me check...
One moment...
I'm looking into it...

instructions_form.identityDescription: What the agent is: name, company/context and main role
instructions_form.identityPlaceholder: You are Caio, an agent at Claro Business. Your role is to qualify clients and prepare opportunities before transferring.
instructions_form.objectivePlaceholder: Quickly understand the customer's need, qualify and forward with context for conversion.
instructions_form.prohibitionsDescription: List of things the agent must NOT do (one per line)
instructions_form.prohibitionsPlaceholder:
Do not sell directly
Do not mention pricing
Do not act as technical support
Do not transfer without context
Do not insist after refusal
instructions_form.toneOfVoicePlaceholder: Speak naturally, lightly and directly. Use expressions like "Got it", "Great", "Makes sense".
instructions_form.dialogExamplesDescription: Snippets of ideal conversation between agent and customer to guide behavior
instructions_form.dialogExamplesPlaceholder:
Customer: Hi, I need help with internet for my company
Agent: Hi! Got it, tell me more about your company — how many people use the internet there daily?
instructions_form.flowDescription: What to do in each scenario (sales, support, close, etc.)
instructions_form.flowPlaceholder:
Sales → continue qualification
Support → transfer to technical team
No sense → close politely
Residential → validate ID before continuing
instructions_form.transferRulesDescription: When and how to transfer to a human, with what context to send
instructions_form.transferRulesPlaceholder:
Transfer when the client is qualified and interested.
Send along: name, company, need, number of people.
Never transfer without collecting at least name and need.
instructions_form.fallbackDescription: What to do when the agent cannot understand or help the customer
instructions_form.fallbackPlaceholder: If not understood after 2 attempts, say: "I'm sorry, I couldn't understand. I'll transfer you to an agent who can help you better."
instructions_form.qualificationDescription: Data the agent should collect during the conversation
instructions_form.qualificationPlaceholder: E.g.: Number of people, Location, Urgency...

agent.knowledgeBaseDescription: Upload TXT or PDF files to enrich the agent's context. Knowledge is automatically appended to instructions.
agent.agentToolsDescription: Define which tools (functions) the agent can call during a conversation. Tools are loaded dynamically from the database when the worker starts a new session.
agent.publishedVersionsDescription: Publish immutable snapshots of your agent configuration (instructions + runtime config + tools). Use versions to freeze configs that work and spawn workers with specific versions for testing.
agent.publishNewVersionDescription: This will create an immutable snapshot of the current agent configuration (instructions, runtime config, and tools). The version number will be v{version}.
agent.publishPlaceholder: e.g., Fixed greeting message, added transfer tool...
agent.restoreWarning: Any unsaved changes in your current draft (instructions, runtime config, and tools) will be lost. Consider publishing the current draft as a version first if you want to keep it.
agent.restoreDescription: This will overwrite your current draft with the configuration from
agent.noToolsConfigured: No tools configured for this agent.
agent.noToolsHint: Click "Add Tool" to create an HTTP Request, Pre-Call Hook, or Post-Call Hook.
agent.summarizeWarning: The file will be summarized via AI (gpt-4o-mini) before saving. This reduces tokens and improves real-time performance, but some details may be simplified.
agent.noVersions: No versions published yet. Click "Publish Version" to create the first snapshot of your agent configuration.
agent.greetingModeAuto: Auto (say for ElevenLabs, generateReply for OpenAI)
agent.greetingModeSay: Say — TTS reads text literally (low latency)
agent.greetingModeGenerate: Generate Reply — LLM generates natural response
agent.greetingModeHelp: Say plays the exact greeting text via TTS (fastest). Generate Reply sends the text as instructions to the LLM, which generates a natural response (dynamic but slower).
agent.turnDetectionDescription: Voice Activity Detection — controls when the agent detects the user has stopped speaking and can respond.
agent.turnDetectionPipelineDescription: Pipeline mode: controla como o agente detecta que o usuário terminou de falar.
agent.humanizationDescription: Add human-like behaviors to make the agent sound more natural.
agent.timeoutsDescription: Automatic call termination rules. Leave empty to disable.
agent.orderDescription: Display order. Tools with lower numbers appear first in the agent's tool list.
agent.deleteKnowledgeConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this knowledge item? This action cannot be undone.
agent.deleteToolConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this tool? This action cannot be undone.
agent.deleteAgentConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the agent "{name}"? This will permanently remove the agent configuration, all knowledge items, tools, and deployment history. This action cannot be undone.
agent.name: Name
agent.turnDetectorModelHelp: Turn Detector Model: uses conversation context to decide if the user has finished (avoids interruptions during natural pauses).
agent.turnDetectorSttHelp: STT: detects end by STT endpointing.
